messages.subject: For Olav Magnus Linge | Public affairs, decarbonisation and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Vindegg,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Olav Magnus Linge, Executive Vice President, Communication & Public Affairs.

Hydro's position across aluminium and renewable energy places public policy, industrial decarbonisation, stakeholder confidence and responsible operations close to strategic execution. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today across government, regulators, communities, ESG and executive management.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate institutional and stakeholder matters across operating, environmental, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, translating external expectations into accountable internal action. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a senior discussion about where this operating-side experience might support Hydro's public-affairs, government-relations, sustainability or decarbonisation priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Norsk Hydro.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
